title: iMessage Open Rates & Statistics: 2026 Data
summary: The latest iMessage statistics for business messaging: open rates, response rates, click-through rates, and delivery data. Updated for 2026.
body_markdown:
The statistics above represent platform averages. To achieve or exceed them:


- **Personalize every message.** The top-performing businesses on Sendblue personalize at least the first line of every message. Generic templates underperform by 30-40%.
- **Use the right message type.** Conversational messages outperform broadcast-style messages. Frame your outreach as a conversation starter, not an announcement.
- **Leverage rich media.** Messages with images see 15% higher click-through rates. Contact cards (vCards) increase save rates dramatically.
- **Send at optimal times.** Use the timing data above to maximize engagement windows.
- **Follow up appropriately.** A single follow-up message 3-5 days after the initial outreach increases overall response rates by 25%.
